description: Bid coverage: uncovered lines, substitutions, partial quantities and conditional bundles — Checks which required lines of a tender or RFQ are covered by the bids received (up to 200 lines, 30 bidders, 2000 offers), for an agent comparing responses. A line is covered when firm offers (exact item, no condition, no bundle) sum to the required quantity; substitute offers, offers bound to a bundle (all-or-nothing across the lines in that bundle) and offers with a stated condition are reporte

bundle.description: Bundle id: the offer holds only if the bidder is awarded every line carrying the same bundle id.

condition.description: Any stated condition (minimum spend, lead time, award of another lot).

quantity.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

substitute.description: The bidder offers a different item than specified.
